title: aikidoe CLI --json output
description: Every doe command run with --json writes one JSON object to stdout: an envelope (schema version, command, ok, text — the notes the command would have printed) and the command's results; on failure ok is false, error.message says why, and the exit code is non-zero. Numbers that are not finite (NaN, ±Infinity) are written as null. Coefficients are in coded units.

efficiency.description: layout efficiency for the design's model (1 = position costs nothing)

zPrime.description: Z′ per plate from the positive and negative controls

potency.description: ED50 reference ÷ ED50 test from the parallel fit

seLogEC50.description: --quality: se of log EC50 at the guess

ratio.description: exp of the estimate and interval: a rate ratio (log link) or odds ratio (logit)

oneOf.description: a generalised linear model (a count or proportion response, issue #64)
a count or proportion response with a random intercept per whole plot or block (GLMM by adaptive Gauss–Hermite quadrature or Laplace)

groupLevel.description: coefficients that vary only between groups: t on dfGroups df, standard errors scaled

reduction.description: --reduce: backward elimination by likelihood-ratio tests (F on the group df for terms that vary only between groups) or AICc

link.description: glm: the prediction on the link scale

items.description: predLower and predUpper (the interval for one new run) are given for least-squares and mixed models, not for counts and proportions (kind glm).

sigma.description: Δ/σ power (a measurement); absent for counts and proportions

ratio.description: Δ/σ detectable (measurements), or the ratio assessed (counts and proportions)

detectableRatio.description: counts and proportions: the smallest ratio detected with the target power

test.description: split-plot counts: F on dfGroups df for a term that changes only between whole plots, χ² otherwise

distribution.description: counts and proportions (issue #64): the response's distribution; power for a ratio

baseline.description: the mean count (per unit exposure) or proportion at the centre of the design

ratio.description: the rate or odds ratio (low → high) the power is for, or one per term

wholePlots.description: split-plot counts and proportions (--sigma-wp): the number of whole plots

dfGroups.description: the df of the whole-plot F tests: whole plots − coefficients constant within them

sigmaWholePlot.description: σ of the whole-plot shift on the link scale (--sigma-wp)

exercise.description: exercise new / run / answer / grade / topics: the fields of the subcommand
